errors.text_span: Im rechten Diagramm werden die Ausgaben der einzelnen Gebietskörperschaften als separate, nebeneinander stehende Balken dargestellt
errors.evidence: The right diagram does not show separate, side-by-side bars; it uses stacked bars similar to the left diagram.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the left diagram represents gross fixed capital investments and the right diagram represents net fixed capital investments.

The machine-generated description does not mention the significant trends in the left diagram, such as the high values in the early 1990s, the decline until 2000, and the stable development afterward.

The machine-generated description does not mention the trends in the right diagram, such as the lower values compared to the left diagram, the negative values after the early 1990s, and the slight upward movements after 2015.
The machine-generated description does not specify that the vertical axis represents percentages of GDP.

The machine-generated description does not mention the approximate values of the black line in both diagrams, such as the values over 3% in the early 1990s in the left diagram and the values around 0.7% in the early 1990s in the right diagram.
